issues.legal_issue: The evidence was insufficient to establish Indian citizenship in a suit seeking a declaration of nationality and protection against deportation.
material_facts: The claimants relied on oral testimony about family residence, birth, land use, schooling, work and residence in India, but produced no supporting records such as birth, school, voter or ration documents.
The alleged land document was not marked or put in evidence at trial, and the person said to have leased the land produced no proof of ownership.

The trial court and first appellate court found that the claimants had not established their Indian citizenship; the Supreme Court also considered the land document and found it provided no sufficient basis to reach a different conclusion.
issues.conclusion: The claimants did not establish that they were Indian citizens, and the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: A claimant seeking a declaration of Indian citizenship must establish the claim with evidence. The Court relied on the insufficiency of the evidence and the concurrent findings of the courts below; it cited no statutory provision or earlier case.

predicates.citizenship_declaration_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal from the dismissal of a claim seeking a declaration of citizenship.
predicates.supporting_records_absent: The claimants did not produce records supporting their assertions about birth, education, residence, work or civic registration.
predicates.oral_testimony_unconvincing: The courts did not accept the claimants’ oral testimony as sufficient proof of their asserted connection to the country.
predicates.land_document_unproved: The document relied on to support the land claim was not proved in evidence, and the purported lessor did not establish ownership of the land.
predicates.citizenship_not_established: The claimants’ evidence does not establish their citizenship.

issues.definition: When a citizenship declaration appeal is supported by no corroborating records, or by unconvincing oral testimony and an unproved land document, the claimants have not established citizenship.
